# Alderman & Sons Funeral Home

> Alderman & Sons is a fourth-generation, family-owned funeral home at 214 West State Street in Media, Pennsylvania. A member of the family answers the telephone at any hour, every day. Services include traditional burial, cremation, green burial, celebrations of life and veterans' services, with prices published online.
